function.name: retrieve_products
function.description: Retrieve products relevant to the current video and public behavior history. This is an information call and counts toward the limit of three calls per video.

function.name: inspect_product
function.description: Inspect public catalog facts for one currently visible product. This information call counts toward the limit of three calls per video.

product_id.description: A product ID copied from visible_product_ids.

function.name: compare_products
function.description: Compare two to four currently visible products on public price, attributes, and fit. This information call counts toward the limit of three calls per video.

items.description: A product ID copied from visible_product_ids.

function.name: read_reviews
function.description: Read the public review summary and disclosed risks for one currently visible product. This information call counts toward the limit of three calls per video.

product_id.description: A product ID copied from visible_product_ids.

function.name: find_alternatives
function.description: Find cheaper or otherwise substitutable products for one currently visible product. This information call counts toward the limit of three calls per video.

product_id.description: The visible product for which alternatives are requested.

function.name: find_complements
function.description: Find genuinely complementary products for one currently visible product. This information call counts toward the limit of three calls per video.

function.name: check_inventory
function.description: Check current public availability for one to four visible products. This information call counts toward the limit of three calls per video.

items.description: A product ID copied from visible_product_ids.

product_ids.description: Visible products whose inventory should be checked.

function.name: commit_recommendation
function.description: Commit exactly one intervention for the current video. The flat fields implement When--What--How: decision is When; product_ids and relationship are What; surface and strategy are How. Evidence IDs must be copied from the current evidence_ids. Use no_recommend when intervention would be irrelevant or repetitive after purchase.

decision.description: When: intervene now, delay, or do not recommend.

surface.description: How: the user-visible intervention surface; use none otherwise.

items.description: A product ID copied from visible_product_ids.

product_ids.description: What: visible products selected for the intervention; empty when not recommending.

relationship.description: What: role of the selected product set; use primary when not recommending.

strategy.description: How: a non-none presentation strategy for recommendations; use none otherwise.

items.description: An evidence ID copied from the current evidence_ids.
